title: Program units are a document setting: every post writes mm or inch from the document, not from the machine file

labels.name: in-review
labels.description: Fix pushed on a branch with an open PR; merges at the next cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Maintainer decision (2026-11-11, in chat, on #901): "the units should come from a 'global setup' rather than a localized setup with operations or the machine settings.. all machines can handle mm and inch and degrees and radians.. just a matter of post output.. that setting should come from a global setting for the document rather than machine or post."

Today: the posted unit comes from the machine file (`kinematics.default.units.length` -> `machine.units`), and only the three Tormach posts read it. The document's Units choice (`SetUnits`, a radio on the Stock page) is display-only. So the user cannot find where the program's unit is set, and most posts cannot post inch at all.

Wanted:
- One document-level setting decides the unit of the posted program for every post. Recommended: the document's existing Units choice (`SetUnits`, already saved in the project file and already an undoable command with history) becomes the program unit too - one setting, not two. A second, separate derivation anywhere (machine file, post option, setup, operation) is a bug.
- The machine file's `units.length` only says which unit the file's own numbers are written in (the parser already scales them to mm); it no longer chooses the program unit. The Tormach posts switch from `machine.units` to the document's unit.
- Every post writes the program in the document's unit: inch = lengths / 25.4 at four decimals, feeds and other length-bearing words converted, and the dialect's unit word (G20 / G21, Heidenhain G70 / G71, Sinumerik G70 / G71 or G700 / G710) in the opening block. A post whose control cannot run a unit (Carvera's firmware halts on G20) refuses that document by name instead.
- The setting lives where a user looks for a document-wide choice (not only on the Stock page), and the post dialog states the unit the program will be written in.
- MCP: the existing units tool (or a new one, `area:mcp`) covers it; `EndUnits` (#596) keeps working against the document's unit.

Open point for the maintainer: angles. Every post writes rotary words in degrees today and nothing in the document chooses an angle unit. If a document-level angle unit (degrees / radians) is wanted for display or output, say so and it is filed as its own issue; it is not part of this one.

Depends on #901 (each post states the unit it writes) - land that first.

Done means: with the document set to inch, each shipped post either writes a correct inch program with its unit word (golden per post, numbers checked against the mm golden / 25.4) or refuses by name; with it set to mm, output is unchanged apart from #901's unit word; no post reads `machine.units` for the program unit; the setting is reachable at document level in the UI and through MCP.
